+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios import api
+from ansible.modules.net_tools.nios import nios_fixed_address
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from .test_nios_module import TestNiosModule
+
+
+class TestNiosFixedAddress(TestNiosModule):
+    module = nios_fixed_address
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestNiosFixedAddress, self).setUp()
+        self.connector_patch = patch('ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api.get_connector')
+        self.connector_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.connector_patch.stop()
+        super(TestNiosFixedAddress, self).tearDown()
+
+    def _args(self, address, network, state='present', check=False):
+        args = dict(name='printer', ipaddr=address, mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                    network=network, provider={}, state=state)
+        if check:
+            args['_ansible_check_mode'] = True
+        set_module_args(args)
+
+    def _wapi(self, objects):
+        wapi = api.WapiModule
+        get_object = Mock(return_value=objects)
+        create = Mock()
+        update = Mock()
+        delete = Mock()
+        with patch.object(wapi, 'get_object', get_object, create=True), \
+                patch.object(wapi, 'create_object', create, create=True), \
+                patch.object(wapi, 'update_object', update, create=True), \
+                patch.object(wapi, 'delete_object', delete, create=True):
+            result = self.changed(changed=not bool(objects) or self.module_state == 'absent' or self.modified)
+        return result, get_object, create, update, delete
+
+    def test_ipv4_create_and_lookup(self):
+        self._args('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.0/24')
+        self.module_state = 'present'
+        self.modified = False
+        _, lookup, create, _, _ = self._wapi(None)
+        lookup.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(lookup.call_args[0][0], api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS)
+        self.assertEqual(lookup.call_args[0][1], dict(ipv4addr='192.0.2.10',
+                                                      mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                                                      network='192.0.2.0/24', network_view='default'))
+        self.assertEqual(create.call_args[0][1]['name'], 'printer')
+
+    def test_ipv6_create(self):
+        self._args('2001:db8::10', '2001:db8::/64')
+        self.module_state = 'present'
+        self.modified = False
+        _, lookup, create, _, _ = self._wapi(None)
+        self.assertEqual(lookup.call_args[0][0], api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS)
+        self.assertEqual(create.call_args[0][1]['ipv6addr'], '2001:db8::10')
+
+    def test_existing_address_is_idempotent(self):
+        self._args('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.0/24')
+        self.module_state = 'present'
+        self.modified = False
+        current = [dict(_ref='fixedaddress/ref', name='printer', ipv4addr='192.0.2.10',
+                        mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24',
+                        network_view='default')]
+        _, _, create, update, delete = self._wapi(current)
+        create.assert_not_called()
+        update.assert_not_called()
+        delete.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_check_mode_delete(self):
+        self._args('2001:db8::10', '2001:db8::/64', state='absent', check=True)
+        self.module_state = 'absent'
+        self.modified = False
+        current = [dict(_ref='ipv6fixedaddress/ref', name='printer', ipv6addr='2001:db8::10',
+                        mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='2001:db8::/64',
+                        network_view='default')]
+        _, _, create, update, delete = self._wapi(current)
+        create.assert_not_called()
+        update.assert_not_called()
+        delete.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_invalid_address(self):
+        self._args('invalid', '192.0.2.0/24')
+        result = self.failed()
+        self.assertIn('ipaddr must be', result['msg'])
+
+    def test_update_comment(self):
+        self._args('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.0/24')
+        self.module_state = 'present'
+        self.modified = True
+        current = [dict(_ref='fixedaddress/ref', name='printer', ipv4addr='192.0.2.10',
+                        mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24',
+                        network_view='default', comment='old')]
+        # Supply a changed comment through the module arguments.
+        set_module_args(dict(name='printer', ipaddr='192.0.2.10', mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                             network='192.0.2.0/24', comment='new', provider={}))
+        _, _, create, update, delete = self._wapi(current)
+        create.assert_not_called()
+        delete.assert_not_called()
+        self.assertEqual(update.call_args[0][0], 'fixedaddress/ref')
+        self.assertEqual(update.call_args[0][1]['comment'], 'new')
+
+    def test_options_sanitize(self):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.params = {'options': [dict(name='domain-name', num=None, value='example.com'),
+                                     dict(name=None, num=6, value='192.0.2.1', use_option=False)]}
+        self.assertEqual(nios_fixed_address.options(module),
+                         [dict(name='domain-name', value='example.com', use_option=True,
+                               vendor_class='DHCP'),
+                          dict(num=6, value='192.0.2.1', use_option=False,
+                               vendor_class='DHCP')])
